fixture_notice: Synthetic deterministic inputs derived from the owner's trip reports. They are regression evidence, not claims about current venue operations.

HARD_OPEN_INTERVAL.description: A visit must fit a verified opening and last-entry interval.

HARD_SHOW_INTERVAL.description: A timed show claim must match a verified show interval and type.

HARD_TRANSPORT_MODE_ALLOWED.description: A route may use only a mode permitted on that route.

READY_REQUIRES_ACCESS_EVIDENCE.description: Unknown required access evidence prevents Ready status.

READY_REQUIRES_ROUTE_EVIDENCE.description: Unknown required route evidence prevents Ready status.

SOFT_BEST_TIME_WINDOW.description: Prefer the supported viewing window or expose the weaker-time consequence.

SOFT_PLAIN_WALK_LOAD.description: Keep plain transfer walking within the confirmed threshold or expose a tradeoff.

SOFT_PHYSICAL_LOAD.description: Keep total physical load within traveller thresholds or expose a tradeoff.

WALK_REWARD_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE.description: Walking earns experience value only with named evidence-supported highlights.

ROUTE_EXPERIENCE_REQUIRES_TIME_EVIDENCE.description: A route earns view value only when the claimed experience is supported at that time.

WEATHER_CLUSTER_REQUIRES_FALLBACK.description: A weather-sensitive half-day needs a nearby verified fallback.

FALLBACK_REOPTIMIZES_DAY.description: Activating a fallback reruns the remaining day and preserves timeline validity.

SOFT_EXPECTED_VALUE.description: Weak expected value must affect ranking or be explained as a tradeoff.

SOFT_TOURIST_TRAP_RISK.description: Tourist-trap risk must be visible and preference-aware.

SOFT_CROWD_RISK.description: Crowd risk must be visible and preference-aware.

SOFT_QUEUE_WAIT.description: Queue time counts toward visit and meal timing.

SOFT_MEAL_WINDOW.description: Meals should fit the confirmed window or expose the affected traveller and consequence.

SOFT_HEAT_EXPOSURE.description: Heat exposure counts toward physical-load and comfort thresholds.

SOFT_BACKTRACKING.description: Avoid removable A-to-B-to-A travel and repeated hotel returns.

HOTEL_AREA_GLOBAL_EFFICIENCY.description: Compare an unbooked hotel area against all day clusters and arrival/departure anchors.

ACCESS_INSTRUCTIONS_REQUIRED.description: A complex entrance needs a verified gate, approach, or landmark instruction.

EXPLICIT_TRADEOFF_REQUIRED.description: Any threshold exception needs owner acceptance and quantified consequences.

SELECTED_ITEM_RECONCILIATION.description: Every selected item must be Fits, Fits with tradeoff, or Cannot currently fit.

CONTINUOUS_TIMELINE.description: Every revised day must remain non-overlapping with all required travel and buffers.

facts.value: Use the signed east entrance beside the station exit.
